title: Tuition installment and October rent
instruction: My tuition installment is on the Student Accounts statement. Don't pay it before my financial-aid refund arrives (the date is on the aid notice); that refund is what pays it, and I need the money in checking until then. It must go out by October 25, because I register for spring classes on the 26th and want it paid before then. Set it up now so it goes out automatically; I won't be checking in. Also make sure October rent is paid on time.

documents.title: Financial aid refund notice
documents.text:
OFFICE OF FINANCIAL AID - REFUND NOTICE
Notice date: October 9, 2026
Your fall 2026 financial aid refund of $1,500.00 has been approved. It will be deposited to your checking account by direct deposit on October 20, 2026.

documents.text:

documents.text:

hidden.floor_notes: P6 replays the reference plan without interaction and passes: the task is static, so it tests honoring a user-set window with an advance instruction, not reaction to new information.
